description: This file defines the Keys class within the OAuth2 API namespace of SuiteCRM. It provides methods to retrieve or generate RSA public and private keys for OAuth2 authentication, including key setup functionality.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Handles retrieval and setup of RSA public/private key pair for OAuth2 authentication.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Returns the contents of the public key file, generating keys if necessary.

methods.name: getPrivateKey
methods.description: Returns the contents of the private key file, generating keys if necessary.

methods.name: setUpKeys
methods.description: Generates a new RSA key pair and saves them to the filesystem.
